blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Egocentric video question answering enables blind and low-vision (BLV) users to query their immediate surroundings through natural language. However, existing benchmarks and models primarily optimize for semantic agreement with reference answers, reducing visual assistance to a purely factual matching task. In real-world scenarios, a factually correct response remains practically unhelpful if it lacks the spatial orientation, actionable detail, or conciseness required by the immediate task of the user. Drawing upon real BLV egocentric videos and authentic user queries from EgoBlind, we construct the PA-EgoQA, a preference-aligned dataset that reconstructs reference answers according to empirical BLV communication criteria. Based on this dataset, we introduce Preference-Aligned Visual Egocentric Learning (PAVE), a unified learning and inference framework that couples structured answer-policy fine-tuning with deterministic question-conditioned routing to adapt response formulation directly to the surface form of the query at inference time. We further align the model via Filter-GRPO, which pairs a hierarchical correctness-quality reward with contrast-based candidate-group filtering to extract learning signals from both factual accuracy contrasts and fine-grained quality variations among correct answers. Extensive experiments across three vision-language backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in factual accuracy alongside substantial gains in assistive response quality. These results establish a concrete paradigm for translating human-centered response requirements into egocentric supervision, generation policies, and post-training objectives. Code will be provided at https://github.com/shawnliang420/PAVE.
blocks.zh: 以Egocent为中心视频提问的回答,使得盲目和低视(BLV)用户能够通过自然语言查询其周围环境. 然而,现有的基准和模型主要优化了语义上与参考答案的协议,将视觉协助减少为纯粹的事实匹配任务. 在现实世界的情景中,事实正确的反应如果缺乏用户眼前任务所要求的空间取向、可操作的细节或简洁性,则实际上仍然无济于事。 根据真实的 BLV 自我中心视频和来自EgoBlind 的真实用户查询,我们构建了 PA-EgoQA,一个偏好相通的数据集,按照经验BLV 通信标准重建参考答案. 基于这个数据集,我们引入了PAVE-相通视觉 Egocentral Learning(PAVE),这是一个统一的学习和推论框架,夫妇用确定性问题条件的路由结构化的答案政策微调,在推论时间直接使响应配方适应询问的表面形式. 我们通过Filter-GRPO进一步调整该模型,将分级正确性质量奖励与基于对比的候选人组过滤相配,从事实准确性对比和正确答案中精细的质量差异中提取学习信号。 跨越三个视觉语言主干线的广泛实验表明,事实准确性不断提高,同时在辅助反应质量方面取得了显著提高。 这些成果为将以人为本的应对要求转化为以自我为中心的监督、生成政策和培训后目标确立了具体的范例。 将在https://github.com/shawnliang420/PAVE中提供代码。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Multimodal Web accessibility services increasingly rely on natural-language responses as an interface between users and visual information. For blind and low-vision (BLV) users ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) , open-ended egocentric video question answering (VideoQA) offers a vital mechanism to request situated assistance. Typical requests range from reading a display or locating an object to operating a control or interpreting a dynamic scene ( Zhang et al., 2021 ; Hwang et al., 2024b ) . In such interfaces, generated responses serve as an accessible representation of visual evidence. Our key insight is that factual correctness and task-specific assistive utility are fundamentally distinct: an answer can be visually accurate yet practically unhelpful if it omits the precise spatial, procedural, or factual granularity demanded by the immediate task of the user. Reconciling this discrepancy between semantic accuracy and situated communication quality constitutes a central challenge for user-centered multimodal Web accessibility ( Hu et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 多式联运 网络无障碍服务越来越依赖自然语言的响应作为用户和视觉信息之间的接口. 对于盲目和低视(BLV)用户(郑等人,2026年;郑等人,2024年),开放式的以自我为中心的视频问题回答(VideoQA)提供了请求定位援助的重要机制. 典型的请求范围从读取显示或定位物体到操作控制或解释动态场景不等(Zhang等人,2021年;Hwang等人,2024年b). 在这种界面中,生成的回复可成为视觉证据的无障碍体现。 我们的关键见解是,事实正确性和特定任务的辅助作用是根本不同的:如果一个答案省略了用户眼前任务所要求的精确的空间、程序或事实颗粒性,那么它就可能具有视觉上的准确性,但实际上却无济于事。 调和语义准确性与定位通信质量之间的这种差异,对以用户为中心的多模式网络无障碍构成了中心挑战(Hu等人,2026年;Zheng等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Although recent studies provide essential building blocks for this domain ( Hwang et al., 2026a ; Hwang et al., 2026c ; Hwang et al., 2024a ) , existing resources and human preference findings remain disconnected. On the benchmark side, EgoBlind ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) curates first-person videos from the daily lives of BLV individuals alongside authentic user-verified questions. This resource enables the study of situated visual assistance well beyond conventional scene captioning. Nevertheless, its reference annotations and evaluation protocols focus primarily on semantic agreement rather than assistive communication quality. Conversely, human-centered studies on BLV assistance establish the importance of structured organization, explicit user-relative spatial cues, and a careful balance between informational sufficiency and conciseness ( Kim et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) . However, these studies stop short of translating empirical guidelines into actionable learning signals. Consequently, operationalizing human preference principles across training supervision, inference routing, and post-training optimization for open-ended egocentric VideoQA remains an open problem.
blocks.zh: 虽然最近的研究为这个领域提供了重要的组成部分(Hwang等人,2026a); Hwang等人,2026c;Hwang等人,2024a),现有资源和人员偏好调查结果仍然脱节。 基准方面,EgoBlind(Xiao等人,2026年)将BLV个人日常生活中的第一人称视频与真实的用户验证问题一起解析. 这一资源使得能够研究定位视觉协助远远超出常规场景字幕。 尽管如此,其参考说明和评价协议主要侧重于语义协议而不是辅助性沟通质量. 反之,以人为中心的关于BLV援助的研究确定了结构化组织、明确的用户相对空间提示以及信息充足性和简洁性之间的谨慎平衡的重要性(Kim等人,2025年;Zhao等人,2025年)。 然而,这些研究未能将经验性准则转化为可采取行动的学习信号。 因此,将人的偏好原则贯穿培训监督、推论路线和培训后优化以开放自我为中心的视频QA,仍然是一个公开的问题。

blocks.en: Based on this observation, we formulate assistive response generation as a preference-aligned decision process and introduce PAVE ( P reference- A ligned V isual E gocentric Learning), a unified framework for preference-informed learning and single-pass routed inference. Diverse assistive tasks impose fundamentally different structural demands. For instance, a text-reading query calls for an exact factual readout, whereas an object-localization or procedural query requires ego-relative orientation or ordered action steps. To address these needs, PAVE unifies reference supervision, query-conditioned policy selection, and post-training optimization under a shared set of BLV communication requirements. This end-to-end alignment enables the system to generate task-appropriate final answers directly from visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 基于这一看法,我们制定辅助反应生成法,作为偏好相适应的决策过程,并引入了PAVE(P参考-A 相匹配的V是Egocentle Learning),这是一个偏好知情学习和单路由推论的统一框架. 各种辅助性任务提出了根本不同的结构要求。 例如,一个读文本的查询需要准确的事实读出,而对象定位或程序查询则需要自我相对的方向或命令的行动步骤。 为了满足这些需要,PAVE根据一套共同的BLV通信要求,统一了参考资料监督、有查询条件的政策选择和培训后优化。 这种端到端对齐使系统能够直接从视觉证据中生成适合任务的最终答案.

blocks.en: Specifically, PAVE operates across three connected stages. First, we construct PA-EgoQA, a preference-aligned egocentric VideoQA dataset, by reconstructing the reference answers of EgoBlind around six BLV-informed criteria: Direction Accuracy, Depth Accuracy, Safety and Actionability, No Hallucination, Sufficiency, and Conciseness. Four reviewers conduct a full-coverage, video-grounded verification of the reconstructed QA pairs and original question intent. Second, we couple structured answer-policy fine-tuning with a deterministic question-form router. This design adapts response formulation directly to the surface form of the query at inference time without introducing an auxiliary routing network. Third, we align the model via Filter-GRPO , which pairs a hierarchical correctness-first reward with contrast-based candidate-group filtering. Groups containing both correct and incorrect answers support factual discrimination, whereas groups of exclusively correct answers with varying quality scores provide a clean learning signal for refining assistive expression. At deployment, the resulting system operates via single-pass greedy decoding, requiring neither reward-model calls nor multi-candidate voting.
blocks.zh: 具体而言,PAVE在三个相关阶段运作。 首先,我们构建了PA-EgoQA, 即一个偏好相适应的自我中心视频QA数据集, 将EgoBlind的参考答案重构为六个BLV知情标准:方向精确度、深度精确度、安全和可操作性、无幻觉度、充足度和简明度。 4名审查人员对重建的QA对和原问意进行了全覆盖,视频化的验证. 第二,我们用一个确定性的问题形式路由器对结构化的答案政策进行微调。 这种设计在推论时间将响应配方直接适应查询的表面形式,而没有引入辅助的路由网络. 第三,我们通过Filter-GRPO调整模型,将等级正确性第一的奖励与基于对比的候选组过滤对齐. 包含正确或不正确答案的群体支持事实上的歧视,而质量分数不同的完全正确答案群体则为完善辅助表达提供了干净的学习信号。 在部署时,产生的系统通过单行道贪婪的解码操作,既不需要奖励模式的呼叫,也不需要多候选人投票.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments on PA-EgoQA demonstrate that PAVE consistently outperforms matched EgoBlind baselines across all three primary backbones, improving factual accuracy by 4.12%, 4.30%, and 0.83%, respectively. Furthermore, PAVE achieves substantial gains in assistive quality while reducing response length by up to 50.8%. By translating human-centered communication preferences into concise, spatially grounded, and actionable guidance under low-latency single-pass inference, PAVE lowers the cognitive load of real-world visual assistance. Ultimately, our framework empowers BLV individuals to navigate and interact with their daily environments with greater independence and safety.
blocks.zh: 关于PA-EgoQA的广泛实验表明,PAVE在所有三个主要主干线上的业绩始终高于EgoBlind基线,事实准确性分别提高了4.12%、4.30%和0.83%。 此外,PAVE在辅助质量方面取得显著进展,同时将反应时间缩短至50.8%。 通过将以人为本的通信偏好转化为简洁的,空间化的,在低纬度单通道推论下可操作的指导,PAVE降低了现实世界视觉协助的认知负荷. 归根结底,我们的框架赋予了BLV个人以更大的独立性和安全性来导航和与其日常环境互动的能力。

blocks.en: Our primary contributions are summarized as follows: • Preference-aligned egocentric QA dataset (PA-EgoQA). We construct PA-EgoQA, a preference aligned dataset grounded in authentic BLV egocentric videos and user queries from EgoBlind. It reconstructs reference answers around six empirical BLV communication criteria, verified via a full-coverage four-reviewer video audit. • Unified learning and single-pass routed framework (PAVE). We design PAVE to integrate structured answer-policy supervision and deterministic question-form routing with Filter-GRPO . This post-training method pairs a hierarchical correctness-quality reward with contrast-based candidate-group filtering, while preserving single-pass greedy decoding with zero routing overhead. • Comprehensive validation across three VLM backbones. Extensive evaluations on InternVL2.5-8B, LLaVA-OneVision-7B, and Qwen2.5-VL-7B demonstrate that PAVE consistently elevates factual accuracy and BLV assistive quality over matched baselines, while compressing response length by up to 50.8% without additional inference latency.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下: · 偏好与自我为中心的质量保证数据集(PA-EgoQA)。 我们构建了PA-EgoQA,这是一个基于真实的BLV自我中心视频和来自EgoBlind的用户查询的偏好一致数据集. 它围绕6个经验BLV通信标准重建了参考答案,通过全覆盖四审查者视频审计进行验证. • 统一学习和单一通道路由框架。 我们设计PAVE是为了整合结构化的答案政策监督,以及确定性的问题形式与Filter-GPRO的路由. 这种培训后的方法将等级正确性质量奖励与基于对比的候选组过滤相配,同时保留单行道贪婪的解码,零路由管理费用. • 全面验证三个VLM主干线。 对InternVL2.5-8B、LLaVA-One Vision-7B和Quen2.5-VL-7B的广泛评价表明,PAVE持续提高事实准确度和BLV辅助质量高于相应的基线,同时将反应长度压缩50.8%而不增加推论延迟。

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1. Visual Assistance for Blind and Low-Vision Users
blocks.zh: 2.1. 对盲人和低视力使用者的视觉援助

blocks.en:
Visual question answering (VQA) empowers BLV individuals to acquire visual information about their surroundings through natural-language queries ( Gao et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) . Pioneering this direction, VizWiz anchored VQA in authentic accessibility scenarios by collecting photographs and spoken questions directly from blind users ( Gurari et al., 2018 ) . Subsequent research expanded visual assistance into dynamic, temporal, and task-oriented domains. For instance, AssistQ explores procedural task guidance using egocentric instructional videos, whereas EgoTextVQA addresses multi-frame scene-text comprehension from a first-person perspective ( Wong et al., 2022 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) . More recently, EgoBlind curated diverse daily assistance queries from first-person videos captured by BLV users ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) , and WalkVLM investigated continuous navigational support for blind pedestrians ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) .
Beyond wearable interfaces, embodied guide-dog robotics has also advanced human-centered design ( Hwang et al., 2024c ; Yu et al., 2026 ) , visual navigation ( Hwang et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026b ) , task assistance ( Liu et al., 2026a ; Yin et al., 2026 ) , and VLM-based guidance ( Yun et al., 2026 ) . Despite these advances, existing datasets and models primarily optimize for factual agreement rather than the heterogeneous communication demands of BLV users. To address this limitation, we construct PA-EgoQA by reconstructing egocentric reference annotations around six empirical BLV criteria, embedding ego-relative spatial orientation, safety awareness, and conciseness directly into training supervision.
blocks.zh:
视觉问题回答(VQA)授权BLV个人通过自然语言查询获得关于周围环境的视觉信息(Gao等人,2026年;Kim等人,2026年). VizWiz通过直接收集盲人的照片和口头提问,将VQA定位为真实无障碍情景(Gurari等人,2018年)。 随后的研究将视觉援助扩大到动态、时间和面向任务的领域。 例如,Assist Q利用以自我为中心的教学视频探索程序性任务指导,而EgoTextVQA则从第一人称角度处理多帧场景文本理解问题(Wong等人,2022年;Zhou等人,2025年)。 最近,EgoBlind整理了来自BLV用户捕获的第一人称视频(Xiao等人,2026年)的各种日常援助查询,WalkVLM调查了对盲人行人的持续导航支持(Yuan等人,2025年).
除了可穿戴的接口外,包含的导盲犬机器人还推进了以人为本的设计(Hwang等人,2024c;Yu等人,2026),视觉导航(Hwang等人,2026b;Liu等人,2026b),任务协助(Liu等人,2026a; Yin et al., 2026),以及基于VLM的指南(Yun et al., 2026). 尽管取得了这些进展,但现有的数据集和模型主要优化于实际协议,而不是满足BLV用户的多样化通信需求。 为解决这一局限性,我们构建了PA-EgoQA,围绕6个经验性的BLV标准重建了以自我为中心的参考说明,将自我相对的空间导向、安全意识和简明性直接纳入培训监督。

blocks.en: 2.2. Structured Reasoning and Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Assistance
blocks.zh: 2.2. 为多式联运援助进行结构化理性和加强学习

blocks.en:
Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting enhances multi-step reasoning in large language models ( Wei et al., 2022 ) , and Multimodal-CoT extends this paradigm to vision-language tasks via visually grounded rationales ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) . Within accessibility, WalkVLM structures visual perception and navigational decisions through a hierarchical CoT pipeline ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) . Nevertheless, uniform step-by-step reasoning is not universally advantageous. Prior studies demonstrate that while explicit CoT benefits complex reasoning, it can degrade direct perception tasks such as visual grounding and object counting ( Jin et al., 2026 ) . This trade-off has motivated adaptive strategies such as AdaCoT, which selectively triggers reasoning based on query characteristics ( Lou et al., 2025 ) .
In parallel, reinforcement learning, particularly Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , has emerged as an effective mechanism for aligning multimodal models through task-specific rewards and online rollout filtering ( Shen et al., 2025 ; Meng et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Choudhary et al., 2026 ) . Building upon these insights, PAVE couples structured answer-policy supervision with deterministic question-conditioned routing, and introduces Filter-GRPO to jointly learn from factual accuracy contrasts and fine-grained assistive quality variations.
blocks.zh:
激发思维链(COT)增强了大语言模型(Wei等人,2022年)的多步骤推理,Multimote-CoT通过视觉上的基础原理将这一范式扩展到视觉语言任务(Zhang等人,2024年b). 在无障碍范围内,WalkVLM通过一个分级的CoT管道构建视觉感知和导航决策(袁等人,2025年). 然而,统一的逐步推理并非普遍有利。 先前的研究表明,虽然明显的CoT有利于复杂的推理,但它可以降低视觉地面和物体计数等直接感知任务(Jin等人,2026年). 这种权衡激励了AdaCoT等适应性战略,有选择地触发基于查询特性的推理(Lou等人,2025年).
与此同时,强化学习,特别是群体相对政策优化(Shao等人,2024年),已成为通过任务奖励和在线推出过滤来调整多式联运模式的有效机制(Shen等人,2025年;Meng等人,2025年;Zhao等人,2026年;Choudhary等人,2026年)。 基于这些见解,PAVE夫妇在结构化的回答政策监督中采用确定性问题有条件的路径,并引入Filter-GPRO,共同学习实际准确性对比和精细的辅助质量变化。

blocks.en: 2.3. BLV-Centered Response Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.3. 以BLV为中心的反应评价

blocks.en: Standard VQA benchmarks evaluate outputs based on lexical or semantic overlap with references, which fails to capture whether a response delivers actionable and concise guidance for a BLV user ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Liang et al., 2026 ) . Although EgoBlind evaluates multimodal models across first-person queries using semantic matching, it does not decouple core factual correctness from assistive communication quality ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) . Recent human-centered research examines BLV user preferences and introduces accessibility-oriented evaluation criteria along dimensions such as sufficiency, actionability, and conciseness ( Kim et al., 2025 ) . Similarly, WalkVLM-LR integrates preference rewards to suppress verbose descriptions during blind walking assistance ( Li et al., 2026 ) . Advancing beyond isolated evaluation or domain-specific verbosity suppression, our work explicitly decouples core semantic correctness from holistic BLV assistive quality across reference reconstruction, question-conditioned policy routing, and hierarchical post-training optimization.

blocks.en: 3. PA-EgoQA: Preference-Informed Reference-Answer Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 3. PA-EgoQA:优先-参考-答复重建

blocks.en: The practical utility of an egocentric visual assistant is fundamentally bounded by the information that its training references teach it to convey. For BLV users, two candidate responses may agree on the central visual fact while differing substantially in the information required to complete a task. As illustrated in Figure 1 , confirming the presence of a mug suffices for an existence query, whereas retrieving that mug requires an explicit ego-relative spatial relation. To embed such task-critical requirements into training supervision and evaluation standards, we introduce PA-EgoQA, a preference-informed reconstruction of the QA annotations in EgoBlind ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) that elevates each question–reference pair into a high-utility assistive learning target.
blocks.zh: 以自我为中心的视觉助理的实际作用从根本上取决于其培训参考资料所传授的信息。 对于BLV用户来说,两个候选答复可能就中心视觉事实达成一致意见,而完成某项任务所需的信息则大不相同。 如图1所示,确认一个杯子的存在足以进行存在性查询,而收回该杯子则需要明确的自我-相对空间关系. 为了将这种关键的任务要求纳入培训监督和评价标准,我们引入了PA-EgoQA,这是EgoBlind(Xiao等人,2026年)中以偏好为主的QA说明的重建,将每个问题都提升为高实用性辅助学习目标。

blocks.en: 3.1. BLV-Oriented Reconstruction Criteria
blocks.zh: 3.1. 以BLV为主的重建标准

blocks.en: Drawing upon empirical BLV preference studies ( Kim et al., 2025 ) , we establish six complementary criteria for assistive response construction: direction accuracy , depth accuracy , safety and actionability , no hallucination , sufficiency , and conciseness . The salience of each criterion is conditioned on the query: information reading demands exact textual transcription, whereas object localization or appliance operation requires ego-relative directional cues or sequential steps. Across all categories, our overarching principle is minimum sufficient assistance : an answer must concisely communicate all factual and spatial details necessary to fulfill the stated task, without unsupported claims.
blocks.zh: 根据实证的BLV偏好研究(Kim等人,2025年),我们为辅助反应构建制定了六个补充标准:方向准确性、深度准确性、安全和可操作性、无幻觉、充足性和简洁性。 每项标准的显著性都以查询为条件:信息读取需要准确的文字转录,而对象本地化或实用操作则需要自我相对的方向提示或顺序步骤. 在所有类别中,我们的首要原则是提供最低限度的充分援助:答案必须简明扼要地传达完成既定任务所需的所有事实和空间细节,而无需提出无根据的要求。

blocks.en: In egocentric assistance, the final frame of the video segment anchors the current scene state and the immediate perspective of the user, while preceding frames supply essential temporal evidence when targets appear clearer earlier or when motion trajectories and state transitions must be interpreted. Every reconstructed reference in PA-EgoQA remains spatially compatible with the terminal viewpoint, expresses explicit uncertainty when visual evidence is inconclusive, and treats multiple valid references for a single question as distinct alternatives rather than concatenating details, thereby preventing overly verbose generation habits.
blocks.zh: 在以自我为中心的协助中,视频片段的最后帧锁定了当前场景状态和用户的即时视角,而前帧则在目标更清晰之前或运动轨迹和状态过渡必须解释时提供重要的时间证据. 在PA-EgoQA中,每一个重建的引用仍然在空间上与终端视角相容,在视觉证据无定论时,表达出明显的不确定性,并且将单个问题的多个有效引用作为不同的替代品,而不是拼凑细节,从而防止过于动词生成习惯.

blocks.en: 3.3. Dataset Statistics and Comparison

blocks.en: PA-EgoQA comprises 1,302 egocentric video clips and 4,762 questions across six daily assistance categories, providing 2,389 training questions (4,642 QA supervision records) and 2,373 test questions. To support standardized benchmarking while preventing overfitting, the test questions are partitioned into a standard evaluation split of 1,091 questions (2,180 accepted references, which are used across all evaluations herein) and a reserved hold-out split of 1,282 questions. As shown in Table 1 , PA-EgoQA integrates authentic BLV videos, user-verified queries, time-constrained multi-reference grounding, and explicit BLV-oriented response criteria within a unified supervision and evaluation resource. These reconstructed references establish a consistent foundation for supervised fine-tuning, preference-based reinforcement learning, and BLV-centered evaluation. Comprehensive analyses of PA-EgoQA, including the qualitative reconstruction comparisons and detailed distributions are provided in Appendix A.

blocks.zh: 5.2. 定量评价

blocks.en: Overall performance across backbones. Table 2 shows that PAVE consistently outperforms matched EgoBlind baselines across all three backbones. On InternVL2.5-8B, PAVE attains 67.00% accuracy (+4.12%) and a 3.2878 BLV Score (+0.2218). Similarly, LLaVA-OV-7B reaches 63.79% accuracy (+4.30%) and a 3.1210 BLV Score (+0.1063), while Qwen2.5-VL-7B reaches 55.64% accuracy (+0.83%) with comparable assistive quality ( ≈ 2.85 \approx 2.85 ). Notably, all PAVE models surpass the strongest zero-shot baseline (InternVL2.5-8B, 54.35%), improving accuracy by +12.65% on InternVL2.5-8B and +12.83% on LLaVA-OV-7B over their zero-shot counterparts.
blocks.zh: 跨骨干整体表现. 表2显示,PAVE的业绩始终高于所有三个骨干网的EgoBlind基线。 在InternVL2.5-8B上,PAVE的精度达到67.00%(+4.12%),BLV分数达到3.2878(+0.2218). 同样,LLaVA-OV-7B的精度达到63.79%(+4.30%),BLV分数达到3.1210,BLV分数(+0.1063),而Quen2.5-VL-7B的精度达到55.64%(+0.83%),具有可比较的辅助质量(XQ 2.85\约2.85). 值得注意的是,所有PAVE模型都超过了最强的零射线基线(InternVL2.5-8B,54.35%),在InternVL2.5-8B和LLaVA-OV-7B上,其精确度分别比其零射线模型提高了+12.65%和+12.83%。

blocks.en: Task-category performance. Across assistance categories, the InternVL2.5-8B improves Navigation accuracy by +7.43% and reaches 75.10% on Safety Warnings, whereas LLaVA-OV-7B leads on Navigation and Other Resources (Table 2 ). Qwen2.5-VL-7B improves Safety Warnings and Information Reading by +4.89% and +2.11% over EgoBlind. Standard fine-tuning (EgoBlind) struggles on spatial tasks because it imitates viewer-agnostic descriptions. By penalizing vague deictic references via its hierarchical reward, PAVE translates visual cues into precise, ego-relative guidance. Furthermore, while zero-shot VLMs occasionally score higher raw accuracy on Tool Use by listing speculative actions in verbose outputs (guessing both buttons and handles triggers C q = 1 C_{q}=1 despite low utility; Figure 4 ), PAVE enforces concise, hallucination-free guidance, boosting Tool Use accuracy by +16.39% on LLaVA-OV-7B and +1.64% on InternVL2.5-8B alongside substantial BLV Score gains.
blocks.zh: 任务类别性能. 在所有援助类别中,INNVL2.5-8B将导航精度提高7.43%,安全警报达到75.10%,而LLaVA-OV-7B则在导航和其他资源方面领先(表2)。 Quen2.5-VL-7B比EgoBlind改进安全警告和信息读取率+4.89%和+2.11%. 标准微调(EgoBlind)在空间任务上挣扎,因为它模仿了观众-不可知的描述. PAVE通过通过等级奖励来惩罚模糊的贬义引用,将视觉提示转化为精确的,自我相对的指导. 此外,虽然零射VLM偶尔在工具上获得更高的原始精度 通过列出动词输出中的投机动作(尽管实用性低,但猜测键和手柄都触发C q = 1 C q q }=1;图4),PAVE执行简洁,无幻觉的引导,提升工具使用精度在LLaVA-OV-7B和InternVL2.5-8B上的精度为+16.39%,同时获得大量的BLV分数收益.

blocks.en: Fine-grained question-form evaluation. Table 3 partitions the evaluation queries on InternVL2.5-8B by their opening word. PAVE achieves its largest gains over EgoBlind on How (+11.02%), Other (+8.00%), and Yes/No (+4.95%). On procedural How and open-ended Other queries, static fine-tuning under a single uniform prompt (EgoBlind) causes severe adaptation degradation below the zero-shot model (e.g., How accuracy drops from 60.17% to 52.54%). Conversely, our question-conditioned routing preserves concise grounding on direct perception queries while dynamically activating spatial-procedural guidance for complex requests, reversing this degradation to surpass the zero-shot baseline (63.56% on How and 72.00% on Other ). Assistive quality also improves across all six forms, led by BLV Score gains on How (+0.3475) and Yes/No (+0.2809). On Where queries, PAVE improves accuracy by +11.54% over the zero-shot model (matching the 50.00% peak) while elevating the BLV Score by +0.1153 over EgoBlind, showing how regime-shifted quality optimization refines spatial expression even at saturated accuracy (full results in Appendix B.1 ).
blocks.zh: 精细的问法评价. 表3按开口词划分了InternVL2.5-8B上的评价查询. PAVE在How(+11.02%)、其他(+8.00%)和Yes/No(+4.95%)上取得了最大的收益。 程序性和不限成员名额 其他查询,静态微调在单一统一速率(EgoBlind)下会导致零射模型以下的严重适应退化(如准确度如何从60.17%下降到52.54%). 反之,我们以问题为条件的路由方式,保持了对直接感知询问的简明基础,同时动态地激活空间-程序指南,处理复杂的请求,扭转这种降解,使其超过零射线基线(How为63.56%,其他为72.00%)。 在BLV分数收益(+0.3475)和Yes/No(+0.2809)的带领下,辅助质量在所有六种形式中都有提高。 在查询中,PAVE比零射线模型(比50.0%的峰值)提高精度+11.54%,同时将BLV分数比EgoBlind提高+0.1153,显示即使饱和精度也如何改进空间表达(附录B.1的全部结果)。

blocks.en: Inference efficiency and response economy. For BLV users relying on text-to-speech readout, concise responses and low latency are critical. As shown in Table 4 , PAVE compresses mean output length by 50.8% on Qwen2.5-VL-7B (14.71 to 7.23 tokens) and 37.8% on InternVL2.5-8B (10.36 to 6.44 tokens), while maintaining the compact 11.6-token footprint and 4.48 s latency of LLaVA-OV-7B. End-to-end per-query latency decreases from 6.97 s to 6.88 s on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and from 2.66 s to 2.52 s on InternVL2.5-8B. Unlike conventional CoT methods that generate verbose intermediate rationales, PAVE internalizes structured verification during training while supervising solely on concise final answers, delivering high-utility guidance at up to half the token cost.

blocks.en: Effect of visual grounding and temporal context. Table 8 evaluates visual and temporal reliance across four input conditions. Removing visual input (Zero-Frame) reduces accuracy by 24%–39%, confirming strict reliance on visual evidence. Incorporating historical frames (Full Video) improves accuracy over Last-Frame by +6.79% on InternVL2.5-8B and +4.67% on LLaVA-OV-7B. blocks.en: Case visualization on situated queries. Figure 4 visualizes model predictions on a situated manipulation query, illustrating how PAVE improves factual grounding and assistive utility. Zero-shot VLMs frequently hallucinate nonexistent buttons. While EgoBlind identifies the target ( “Pull the door handle” , C q = 1 C_{q}=1 ), it omits spatial orientation ( S q = 3 S_{q}=3 ). PAVE specifies both the ego-relative location ( “to your right” ) and action ( “pull it toward you” ), achieving S q = 5 S_{q}=5 (more details are provided in Appendix B.2 ).

Figure 5 visualizes two challenging scenarios where all evaluated models fail: updating the direction of an exit after a large viewpoint shift, and detecting hazards under severe motion blur. Thus, while PAVE aligns responses with BLV preferences, rapid ego-motion tracking and blurred hazard perception are constrained by the native VLM backbones.
blocks.zh: 失败案例分析和瓶颈。 图5可视化了所有评估模型都失败的两种具有挑战性的情景:在大视线转变后更新退出方向,以及发现严重运动下的危险。 因此,虽然PAVE将反应与BLV偏好相配合,但快速的自我运动跟踪和模糊的危险感受到当地VLM骨干的限制.

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6个 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we address a fundamental discrepancy in egocentric visual assistance for blind and low-vision users: semantic agreement with reference answers does not guarantee situated assistive utility. To bridge this gap, we construct PA-EgoQA, a preference-aligned benchmark that reconstructs supervision around blind empirical communication criteria. Building upon this foundation, we introduce PAVE, a unified learning and single-pass inference framework that explicitly decouples core factual validity from holistic assistive quality. By integrating structured answer-policy supervision, zero-overhead deterministic question-conditioned routing, and contrast-filtered policy optimization, PAVE adapts response formulation to the structural demands of diverse queries while learning from both factual accuracy contrasts and fine-grained quality variations. Extensive quantitative, ablation, and qualitative evaluations across multiple vision-language backbones confirm that our framework simultaneously enhances factual grounding, elevates ego-relative assistive expression, and improves response conciseness without additional inference latency. Ultimately, our work establishes a principled paradigm for human-centered blind and low-vision accessibility requirements.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们解决了盲目和低视线用户在自我中心视觉协助方面的根本差异:语义上与参考答案一致并不能保证定位辅助效用。 为了弥合这一差距,我们建造了PA-EgoQA,这是一个与偏好一致的基准,用以重建对盲目实证通信标准的监督。 在这个基础上,我们引入了PAVE,这是一个统一的学习和单通推论框架,明确将核心事实有效性与整体辅助质量脱钩。 通过整合结构化的答案-政策监督,零管理前提的确定性问题路径,以及对比式过滤的政策优化,PAVE使响应的制定适应了不同询问的结构需求,同时从事实准确性对比和精细质量差异中学习. 跨越多种视觉语言主干网的广泛定量、减缩和定性评价证实,我们的框架同时加强事实基础,提升自我-相对辅助性表达,提高反应简洁度,而不增加推论延迟。 归根结底,我们的工作为以人为中心的盲目和低视力无障碍要求确立了一个原则模式。

blocks.en: Table 9 reports the complete breakdown of factual Accuracy and holistic BLV Score across canonical question forms for all three VLM backbones on the 1,091 evaluation queries, complementing the InternVL2.5-8B analysis in Table 3. Consistent with the main evaluation in Section 5, we compare PAVE against off-the-shelf Zero-Shot baselines and matched EgoBlind fine-tuned baselines. blocks.en: Hardware and optimization hyperparameters. All training and evaluation experiments are conducted on compute nodes equipped with 2 × \times NVIDIA A800 (80GB) GPUs. Both the Structured SFT and Filter-GRPO stages are optimized using AdamW with cosine learning rate schedules. Structured SFT uses linear warmup over the first 3% of training steps, whereas Filter-GRPO uses a 10-step linear warmup. During Structured SFT, we use peak learning rates of 4 × 10 − 5 4\times 10^{-5} , 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , and 2 × 10 − 7 2\times 10^{-7} for InternVL2.5-8B, LLaVA-OV-7B, and Qwen2.5-VL-7B, respectively.
